cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unscheduled, then. I'll lead a practice round before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set a two-minute timer. I'll add you to the rota as timekeeper.
